limitations: explicit caller supplied Unix socket; trusted local peer, no authentication or owner check
one newline JSON request <=65536 bytes; one newline response <=1048576 bytes
original json.loads response semantics preserved, including nonfinite response acceptance
socket timeout applies per operation, not an end-to-end execution deadline
no automatic retries; transport failure after send cannot establish remote outcome
no server, world, clock or task/device semantics created
